description: A unit-price ask is mirrored into the line's requested price. Once the agent reprices the line, cent rounding must not turn that mirror into a fresh buyer ask: no pass may write a price without a reply (H10), and the last write must be what the live quote carries (H11). Whether the ratio drifts depends on the price, so MirroredAsksTest is the deterministic guard; this is the end-to-end net.
